name: Weighted Next-Fight Estimator
definition: An estimator for transmittance (uncollided radiance) derived from a modified Radiative Transfer Equation (RTE) that accounts for losses and a point source. It combines an underestimated uncollided contribution (transmittance through the rest of the combined medium) with null collision sampling to correct for the initial underestimation.
summary: The Weighted Next-Fight Estimator is a Monte Carlo method for estimating transmittance in participating media that explicitly adds transmittance through the rest of the combined medium at each step, unlike its sibling method.
